pureOracle.initialFixtureCorrection: The initial UUID uppercase negative case used a digits-only UUID, so uppercasing did not change it. Corrected that literal to an uppercase alphabet-bearing UUID; no product defect or admission relaxation.

method: Real Chromium IndexedDB motion-studio version 2, actual get/getKey/put/getAll/getAllKeys and transaction complete/abort events; no fake-IDB implementation.
Original literal schema 1 and schema 2 records seeded into genuine version-1 database before native version-2 upgrade; exact raw old-store value compared before/after migration and promotion.
Two actual ProjectLibrary instances race native CAS; independent database reads verify whole winning rows and active pointer.

Declared timing/fault observers preserve native API results: post-put onsuccess aborts actual transaction; repeated actual readonly get requests keep write transaction alive until actual 10-second deadline; readonly onsuccess callback delivery held past real transaction completion.
Opaque receipts tested as unaccepted, cloned, foreign, consumed, pre-timeout and late-read generations; fresh accepted read/project after uncertainty is required.
Oversized malformed native string independently measured with TextEncoder at 6291881 UTF8 JSON bytes, exactly frozen wrapper cap plus one; raw bytes retained.
